app.name: Intelligent Integrated Skill Marketplace
app.tagline: Connecting candidates, courses and jobs through a shared skill graph

hero.title: Find the work you want, and the training that gets you there
hero.subtitle: Tell us the job you are aiming for. We show you exactly which skills you are missing, and the courses that close that gap.
hero.searchLabel: Search for a job role or skill
hero.searchPlaceholder: e.g. General Duty Assistant, welding, retail sales
hero.trust: Free to use · Aligned to the National Skills Qualifications Framework · Hindi and English

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Four steps, from where you are to where you want to be.
how.step1Body: A job you hold now, a job you want, or simply the kind of work you are looking for.
how.step2Body: We compare your skills against what that role actually requires, and show you precisely what is missing.
how.step3Body: We recommend the courses that cover those specific missing skills, ranked by cost, duration and language.
how.step4Body: As your skills grow, better-matched jobs surface automatically.
how.note: Every score is computed deterministically and can be explained, skill by skill.

audiences.title: Built for every side of the market
audiences.candidateBody: Understand what you are missing, and what to do about it. Free, in your language.
audiences.employerBody: Post roles as skills, not keywords. Find candidates who genuinely match.
audiences.providerBody: Publish courses anchored to Qualification Packs, and see which skills the market is short of.
